profile.headline: SWE @ SAIC | Spring 2025 Florida State University Graduate

positions.title: Software Engineer Associate
positions.description:
• Researched and applied a data transformation technique to enable AG Grid functionality with complex nested data.
• Delivered front-end enhancements and worked on 15+ reusable React components and unit-tested them with Jest, improving accessibility
and lowering bug count.
• Wrote secure PostgreSQL migrations and debugged deployment issues.
• Gained hands-on experience with AWS to support secure infrastructure development.
• Collaborated in Agile ceremonies to ensure timely feature delivery and team alignment.

positions.title: Identity Management Intern
positions.description:
• Integrated a new PAM (Privilege Access Management) system using BeyondTrust, Azure Directory, and Java.
• Deleted around 500,000 obsolete rows for archived users by implementing a Java and SQL script executed against FSU’s identity management database, improving maintainability.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Enhanced employee onboarding experience and functionality utilizing PHP, Laravel, and Vue.js to maintain a web application.
Implemented new features and improvements with the product team using AGILE methodology, resulting in a more efficient and user-friendly onboarding process. 
Improved efficiency, performance, and application stability by refactoring code in PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Participated in daily SCRUM and sprint planning, contributing to a productive and dynamic development environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Enhanced mobile and web UX/UI in collaboration with the product development team, significantly improving user engagement. 
Adopted a wide range of programming languages and frameworks to support diverse development projects, showcasing adaptability and a proactive approach to learning. 
Involved in the launch of updates of a cross-platform application, ensuring seamless functionality across multiple devices.
